FactInventory.sql: WITH CurrentFY AS (SELECT TOP (1) FiscalYearId FROM FMK.FiscalYear WHERE StartDate<=GETDATE() ORDER BY StartDate DESC), IA AS (SELECT it.ItemID ItemId,it.Code ItemCode,it.Title ItemTitle,sg.Title SaleGroupTitle,st.StockID StockId,st.Title StockTitle,iss.UnitRef,u.Title UnitTitle,SUM(ISNULL(iss.Quantity,ISNULL(iss.InputQuantity,0)-ISNULL(iss.OutputQuantity,0))) Quantity,SUM(ISNULL(iss.SaleQuantity,0)) SaleQuantity,ISNULL(it.MinimumAmount,0) MinimumAmount,ISNULL(it.MaximumAmount,0) MaximumAmount,CASE WHEN SUM(ISNULL(iss.Quantity,ISNULL(iss.InputQuantity,0)-ISNULL(iss.OutputQuantity,0)))<ISNULL(it.MinimumAmount,0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END BelowMinimum FROM INV.ItemStockSummary iss CROSS JOIN CurrentFY fy JOIN INV.Item it ON it.ItemID=iss.ItemRef JOIN INV.Stock st ON st.StockID=iss.StockRef LEFT JOIN INV.[Group] sg ON sg.GroupID=it.SaleGroupRef LEFT JOIN INV.Unit u ON u.UnitID=iss.UnitRef WHERE iss.FiscalYearRef=fy.FiscalYearId GROUP BY it.ItemID,it.Code,it.Title,sg.Title,st.StockID,st.Title,iss.UnitRef,u.Title,it.MinimumAmount,it.MaximumAmount) SELECT ia.ItemId,ia.ItemCode,ia.ItemTitle,ia.SaleGroupTitle,ia.StockId,ia.StockTitle,ia.UnitTitle,ia.Quantity,ia.SaleQuantity,ia.MinimumAmount,ia.MaximumAmount,ia.BelowMinimum,ISNULL(pr.Fee,0) UnitPrice,pr.Date PriceNoteDate,pd.Jalali_1 PriceNoteDateJalali,pr.Title PriceNoteTitle,CAST(ia.Quantity*ISNULL(pr.Fee,0) AS decimal(38,4)) InventoryValue,CASE WHEN ia.BelowMinimum=1 THEN N'زیر حداقل' ELSE N'عادی' END MinimumStatus FROM IA ia OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) pni.Fee,pn.Date,pn.Title FROM SLS.PriceNoteItem pni JOIN SLS.PriceNote pn ON pn.PriceNoteID=pni.PriceNoteRef WHERE pni.ItemRef=ia.ItemId AND pni.UnitRef=ia.UnitRef AND pni.SaleTypeRef=8 ORDER BY CASE WHEN pni.CustomerGroupingRef IS NULL AND pni.TracingRef IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,pn.Date DESC,pni.PriceNoteItemID DESC) pr LEFT JOIN GNR.DimDate pd ON pd.Miladi=CAST(pr.Date AS date)

FactSales.sql:
SELECT
    N'Sale' AS DocumentType,
    i.InvoiceId AS DocumentId,
    ii.InvoiceItemID AS DocumentItemId,
    i.Number AS DocumentNumber,
    CAST(i.Date AS date) AS DocumentDate,

    fy.Title AS FiscalYear,
    dd.Jalali_1 AS JalaliDate,
    dd.JYear AS JalaliYear,
    dd.JMonthN AS JalaliMonthNumber,
    dd.JMonthT AS JalaliMonthName,
    dd.JQuarterN AS JalaliQuarterNumber,
    dd.JQuarterT AS JalaliQuarterName,

    p.PartyId AS CustomerId,
    p.Name AS CustomerName,
    p.LastName AS CustomerLastName,
    cg.GroupingID AS CustomerGroupId,
    cg.Title AS CustomerGroupTitle,

    sp.PartyId AS SalespersonId,
    sp.Name AS SalespersonName,
    sp.LastName AS SalespersonLastName,

    it.ItemID AS ItemId,
    it.Code AS ItemCode,
    it.Title AS ItemTitle,

    ic.ItemCategoryID AS ItemCategoryId,
    ic.Title AS ItemCategoryTitle,

    sg.GroupID AS SaleGroupId,
    sg.Title AS SaleGroupTitle,

    st.StockID AS StockId,
    st.Title AS StockTitle,

    u.UnitID AS UnitId,
    u.Title AS UnitTitle,

    CAST(ii.Quantity AS decimal(38,4)) AS Quantity,
    CAST(ii.Fee AS decimal(38,4)) AS Fee,
    CAST(ii.PriceInBaseCurrency AS decimal(38,4)) AS GrossPrice,
    CAST(ii.DiscountInBaseCurrency AS decimal(38,4)) AS Discount,
    CAST(ISNULL(ii.AdditionInBaseCurrency, 0) AS decimal(38,4)) AS Addition,
    CAST(ISNULL(ii.TaxInBaseCurrency, 0) AS decimal(38,4)) AS Tax,
    CAST(ISNULL(ii.DutyInBaseCurrency, 0) AS decimal(38,4)) AS Duty,
    CAST(ii.NetPriceInBaseCurrency AS decimal(38,4)) AS NetPrice

FROM SLS.Invoice AS i

INNER JOIN SLS.InvoiceItem AS ii
    ON ii.InvoiceRef = i.InvoiceId

LEFT JOIN FMK.FiscalYear AS fy
    ON fy.FiscalYearId = i.FiscalYearRef

LEFT JOIN GNR.DimDate AS dd
    ON dd.Miladi = CAST(i.Date AS date)

LEFT JOIN GNR.Party AS p
    ON p.PartyId = i.CustomerPartyRef

LEFT JOIN GNR.Grouping AS cg
    ON cg.GroupingID = p.CustomerGroupingRef

LEFT JOIN GNR.Party AS sp
    ON sp.PartyId = p.SalespersonPartyRef

LEFT JOIN INV.Item AS it
    ON it.ItemID = ii.ItemRef

LEFT JOIN INV.ItemCategory AS ic
    ON ic.ItemCategoryID = it.ItemCategoryRef

LEFT JOIN INV.[Group] AS sg
    ON sg.GroupID = it.SaleGroupRef

LEFT JOIN INV.Stock AS st
    ON st.StockID = ii.StockRef

LEFT JOIN INV.Unit AS u
    ON u.UnitID = it.SaleUnitRef

WHERE i.State = 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    N'Return' AS DocumentType,
    ri.ReturnedInvoiceId AS DocumentId,
    rii.ReturnedInvoiceItemID AS DocumentItemId,
    ri.Number AS DocumentNumber,
    CAST(ri.Date AS date) AS DocumentDate,

    fy.Title AS FiscalYear,
    dd.Jalali_1 AS JalaliDate,
    dd.JYear AS JalaliYear,
    dd.JMonthN AS JalaliMonthNumber,
    dd.JMonthT AS JalaliMonthName,
    dd.JQuarterN AS JalaliQuarterNumber,
    dd.JQuarterT AS JalaliQuarterName,

    p.PartyId AS CustomerId,
    p.Name AS CustomerName,
    p.LastName AS CustomerLastName,
    cg.GroupingID AS CustomerGroupId,
    cg.Title AS CustomerGroupTitle,

    sp.PartyId AS SalespersonId,
    sp.Name AS SalespersonName,
    sp.LastName AS SalespersonLastName,

    it.ItemID AS ItemId,
    it.Code AS ItemCode,
    it.Title AS ItemTitle,

    ic.ItemCategoryID AS ItemCategoryId,
    ic.Title AS ItemCategoryTitle,

    sg.GroupID AS SaleGroupId,
    sg.Title AS SaleGroupTitle,

    st.StockID AS StockId,
    st.Title AS StockTitle,

    u.UnitID AS UnitId,
    u.Title AS UnitTitle,

    CAST(-rii.Quantity AS decimal(38,4)) AS Quantity,
    CAST(rii.Fee AS decimal(38,4)) AS Fee,
    CAST(-rii.PriceInBaseCurrency AS decimal(38,4)) AS GrossPrice,
    CAST(-rii.DiscountInBaseCurrency AS decimal(38,4)) AS Discount,
    CAST(-ISNULL(rii.AdditionInBaseCurrency, 0) AS decimal(38,4)) AS Addition,
    CAST(-ISNULL(rii.TaxInBaseCurrency, 0) AS decimal(38,4)) AS Tax,
    CAST(-ISNULL(rii.DutyInBaseCurrency, 0) AS decimal(38,4)) AS Duty,
    CAST(-rii.NetPriceInBaseCurrency AS decimal(38,4)) AS NetPrice

FROM SLS.ReturnedInvoice AS ri

INNER JOIN SLS.ReturnedInvoiceItem AS rii
    ON rii.ReturnedInvoiceRef = ri.ReturnedInvoiceId

LEFT JOIN FMK.FiscalYear AS fy
    ON fy.FiscalYearId = ri.FiscalYearRef

LEFT JOIN GNR.DimDate AS dd
    ON dd.Miladi = CAST(ri.Date AS date)

LEFT JOIN GNR.Party AS p
    ON p.PartyId = ri.CustomerPartyRef

LEFT JOIN GNR.Grouping AS cg
    ON cg.GroupingID = p.CustomerGroupingRef

LEFT JOIN GNR.Party AS sp
    ON sp.PartyId = p.SalespersonPartyRef

LEFT JOIN INV.Item AS it
    ON it.ItemID = rii.ItemRef

LEFT JOIN INV.ItemCategory AS ic
    ON ic.ItemCategoryID = it.ItemCategoryRef

LEFT JOIN INV.[Group] AS sg
    ON sg.GroupID = it.SaleGroupRef

LEFT JOIN INV.Stock AS st
    ON st.StockID = rii.StockRef

LEFT JOIN INV.Unit AS u
    ON u.UnitID = it.SaleUnitRef;

SepidarItems.sql: SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(it.Code AS nvarchar(100)))) AS ItemCode, it.Title AS ItemTitle FROM INV.Item AS it WHERE it.Code IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CAST(it.Code AS nvarchar(100)))) <> N''
